title: The Shape of a God
summary: Draw sigils to work miracles, learn how the sky answers your temper, and discover that every choice moves you along two axes at once.
briefing: Draw with the Spell tool and the world will answer.
A circle brings rain. A line calls lightning. A jagged stroke tears the ground.
What you cast changes what you are — and what you are changes the weather over your island.

quests.title: Work a miracle
quests.description: Select the Spell tool and draw a sigil over your land.

quests.title: Temper of the sky
quests.description: Keep casting. An orderly god calms the weather; a chaotic one storms it.

objectives.text: Shape the weather through repeated miracles

quests.title: Two roads at once
quests.description: Your deeds place you on both the Order-Chaos and Good-Evil axes.

objectives.text: Commit to an alignment through your miracles
